description: Measured crash-game statistics from a published 1,000,000-round dataset (documented crash distribution, RTP 98%): the bust distribution, how sessions at a fixed cash-out target end, and losing-streak data — every figure with its method, its seed and a link to the raw data (Zenodo DOI 10.5281/zenodo.23597144). It measures; it does not predict.
name: crash-round-lab
